tasks.title: Add the stdlib i18n tool: extract, build, pseudo, and check
tasks.acceptance: I6 and I9: extract writes a .pot file from _() calls with an ast scan. build compiles each .po to a .mo that gettext.GNUTranslations reads, and writes a Bash message file with printf %q quoting. pseudo writes a marked catalog. check fails on a missing msgid, a stale .mo or .sh file, and a stale document marker. Only the standard library is imported.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest tests.test_i18n_tool -v; expected: OK, including a .mo round trip through gettext and a failing check for each stale case.

tasks.title: Add the translation helper to each Python skill
tasks.acceptance: I3: translator(domain) reads LAYLA_LANG first (pt-BR becomes pt_BR), then the standard locale variables, with fallback=True. A missing catalog or unknown locale gives English. The two copies are byte-identical.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest tests.test_i18n_helper -v; expected: OK, with tests for LAYLA_LANG, LANGUAGE, an unknown locale, and identical copies.

tasks.title: Externalize the setup.py messages
tasks.acceptance: I1 and I2: every print, parser.error, ArgumentTypeError, and help string in setup.py uses _(). locales/layla-docker.pot exists. English output is byte-identical. A pseudo catalog marks every message.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; expected: OK. The unwrapped-literal test and the pseudo-locale test pass for setup.py.

tasks.title: Externalize the layla_client.py messages
tasks.acceptance: I1 and I2: every help and error message uses _(). The JSON responses from the API stay unchanged. locales/layla-local.pot exists. English output is byte-identical.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; expected: OK. The unwrapped-literal test and the pseudo-locale test pass for layla_client.py.

tasks.title: Localize the layla Bash script with generated message files
tasks.acceptance: I1, I2, and I3: layla sources messages/<locale>.sh when it exists and keeps inline English defaults. setup.py copies messages/. The help text and the 4 messages come from the catalog. The Compose interpolation message stays English. A missing file gives English.
tasks.verify: bash -n skills/layla-docker/assets/container/layla; python3 -m unittest tests.test_i18n_bash -v; expected: exit 0. ./layla help is byte-identical without LAYLA_LANG and marked with the pseudo locale.

tasks.title: Record the upstream language registry at the pinned SHA
tasks.acceptance: Q1 and Q2 have answers with links at 336ee4a: the full list of response_language keys and aliases after the tutor merge, and where the UI interface language is stored.
tasks.verify: Coordinator review of each link at the pinned SHA; expected: each key in the list appears in the linked source.

tasks.title: Add setup.py --language with an upstream allowlist
tasks.acceptance: I5: --language accepts the codes and names from upstream-languages.md, case-insensitive, and writes the canonical value to response_language. The default stays English. An unknown value exits 2 and writes no file.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest tests.test_language_flag -v; expected: OK, with a valid code, a native name, the default, and a rejected value with no side effects.

tasks.title: Add the first locale pt_BR and allow translations in the contract
tasks.acceptance: I4 and I6: AGENTS.md allows translated catalogs and translated human docs, and keeps English as the source. pt_BR .po, .mo, and .sh files are complete for both skills. A skill copied with install-skills.py shows pt_BR text with LAYLA_LANG=pt_BR outside the repository.
tasks.verify: python3 scripts/i18n.py check; python3 scripts/check-style.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; expected: exit 0 for all.

tasks.title: Run the translation check in CI and document how to add a locale
tasks.acceptance: I6: CI and release run python scripts/i18n.py check after check-style. I18N.md gives the steps to extract, translate, build, and check a new locale.
tasks.verify: python3 scripts/i18n.py check; a local run of each new workflow step; expected: exit 0. A changed .po file without a build makes the check fail.

tasks.title: Translate the README to pt-BR with a staleness marker
tasks.acceptance: I7: README.pt-BR.md starts with the SHA-256 marker of README.md. Both files link to each other. README.md documents LAYLA_LANG and --language.
tasks.verify: python3 scripts/i18n.py check; expected: exit 0. A one-line change to README.md makes the check fail.

tasks.title: Tell the agents to reply in the user's language
tasks.acceptance: I8: both skills tell the agent to reply in the user's language and to keep commands, paths, and API fields unchanged. layla-docker names LAYLA_LANG and --language. 0 hard STE violations.
tasks.verify: python3 scripts/check-style.py; python3 scripts/check-skills.py; expected: exit 0.

tasks.title: Record the change in the changelog
tasks.acceptance: The Unreleased section names LAYLA_LANG, --language, the pt_BR locale, and README.pt-BR.md.
tasks.verify: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; python3 scripts/i18n.py check; expected: exit 0.
